description: Any list that can grow without bound is paged, never drawn whole. Lists of rows page at LIST_PAGE (20) through createPager from src/components/styled/pager.tsx; grids of squares page at their grid size (BOX_SIZE for the pokemon box, GRID_SIZE for the item tray). Applies whenever rendering a collection whose length the player controls.
